comment: Ambient talk for The Outpost's people (2026-10-09). Keys are the stable ids on the floor's workers/npcs; E opens one random line per conversation (never the same line twice in a row). Lore stays provisional: see docs/GAME.md and docs/WORLD.md.

npc.outpost_driller_west.name: HESK  ·  ROCK DRILLER
lines: Basalt here is soft as bread next to what's under the Threshold. Enjoy it.
Foundry built half this place. Pumps, winch, the lift car. The other half is held up by hope and rivets.
Shaft goes deeper than anybody's charted. Every shift we drop it another few metres. Every shift something down there notices.
You hear the hammer stop, you look up. Means a slab came loose or somebody's hurt.
Ore's what pays. Limonite, hematite, scrap if you're lucky. Nobody pays for courage.

npc.outpost_driller_east.name: TAMSIN  ·  SURVEYOR
lines: Drift folk read rock the way you read a sign. That vein there? Runs north, dips under the shaft. Told you.
Every map of the deep is wrong by next season. Rock moves. So do the things living in it.
Somebody swore they saw Lumenita glowing past the Shallows. Blue, like a lamp left on. Nobody's brought any back yet.
The Threshold's the only floor with honest light. Past it you bring your own.
I mark the tunnels I come back from. The ones I don't, somebody else can mark.

npc.outpost_signal_west.name: ODA  ·  SIGNAL TECH
lines: Relay keeps the consoles breathing. Half those machines were here before the Outpost was. We just learned which buttons don't bite.
There's a hum under the floor at night. Not ours. Not the generators. I log it and nobody reads the log.
The supercomputer in the control station still answers. Doesn't tell us who built it, though.
Four peoples down here: Foundry forges, Drift wanders, Verdant grows things, Relay talks to machines. The Outpost needs all of us, and we argue about it daily.
Your battery's a Relay cell. Treat it kindly. There's no charging rig past the lift.

npc.outpost_hauler.name: PELL  ·  CARGO HAULER
lines: Verdant grows the moss and the meal here. Without us you'd be eating rust.
Burrowborn don't see you. They feel you. Walk soft in the Shallows and you might pass a nest without waking it.
Hit one Burrowborn and the rock carries it. The rest come running from every tunnel near.
Cargo pods run day and night, yard to rim. If one stops, the whole Outpost goes hungry by week's end.
Spores in the deep tunnels aren't all bad. Some heal. Ask before you lick anything.

npc.outpost_gate_guard.name: KORVIN  ·  GATE GUARD
lines: Castoffs out on the convoy roads. Coats, caps, no colours. They're people, not monsters, which makes them worse.
A Castoff won't fight you fair. You see one, there's three more behind the wreck.
Nobody gets past this street without the Outpost knowing. Including you, newcomer.
Surface fell a long time ago. Up there's wind and salt and scavengers. Down here's work. I know which I'd pick.
Keep your weapon on your back inside the walls. Out there, keep it in your hands.
Lift's the only way down that the Outpost keeps. The rest are holes somebody else dug.
